evals.prompt: Design the Markdown content model from docs/product/specs/markdown-content-model.md. The codebase map is in docs/engineering/architecture.md.
evals.expected_output: A design at docs/engineering/designs/markdown-content-model.md with components mapped to REQs, the content schema in the framework's own form citing its documentation and version, routes and generated artifacts as contracts, build and render flows with a failure path per EDGE, ADRs for decisions with viable alternatives, a verification plan with one row per AC, and check_design.py reporting ok; user-owned decisions asked, not assumed.
assertions: Every REQ, NFR, EDGE and AC id from the specification appears in the design and check_design.py reports ok: true
Every framework API named in the design cites a documentation URL with version or a file in the codebase
Each ADR has at least two options with consequences and names the requirement ids it serves
The verification plan has one concrete check per acceptance criterion
No decision classified as the user's is made silently; such decisions appear as questions with a recommendation

evals.prompt: Desenha a arquitetura da busca. A spec está em docs/product/specs/search.md mas ainda tem uma pergunta aberta sobre o provedor.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads the spec, finds the OPEN that blocks the provider component, and stops with at most three questions with recommended answers instead of designing around a guessed provider; nothing is written to docs/engineering/designs/.
assertions: No design file is written while the blocking OPEN is unresolved
The user is asked at most three questions, each with a recommended answer

evals.prompt: Run the traceability check on this design and fix what it flags.
evals.expected_output: check_design.py reports REQ-2 and AC-2 missing from the design, AC-2 without a verification row, and ADR 0001 with a single option; the fixes add a component for REQ-2, a verification row for AC-2, and either a second option to the ADR or its removal with the decision stated as following from a requirement.
assertions: The check is run before any edit and its findings are listed
REQ-2 gets a component and AC-2 gets a verification row
The single-option ADR is completed with a second option or removed with the decision restated as following from a requirement
The check reports ok: true after the fixes
